name: handler_brrr
title: Progression Handler: Progress Reported as 'BRRR' Sounds (Audio)

origin.description: Build a progression handler that plays BRRR sounds.
origin.usage: handler_brrr(initiate = "takeoff", update = "bigsean4", finish = "khaled3", interrupt = "busta", intrusiveness = getOption("progressr.intrusiveness.audio", 5), target = "audio", ...)

arguments.name: initiate, update, finish, interrupt
arguments.text: Sound names or indices. NA is silence.

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default reads progressr.intrusiveness.audio, or 5.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "audio".

origin.details: requireNamespace("BRRR") fails. The stop message points at ?progressr::handler_notifier(), which is the wording in the installed handler_brrr().
origin.value: A function of class progression_handler. On this machine the package lookup stops before that function is returned.
origin.example:
err <- tryCatch(handler_brrr(), error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
cat("handler_brrr() errors: ", err, ".\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Build a progression handler that would play BRRR sounds.
translation.usage: handler_brrr(initiate="takeoff", update="bigsean4", finish="khaled3", interrupt="busta", intrusiveness=None, target="audio", **extra)

arguments.name: initiate, update, finish, interrupt
arguments.text: Sound names or indices. NA is silence.

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default reads progressr.intrusiveness.audio, or 5.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "audio".

translation.details: The call stops when BRRR is missing. The message names handler_notifier, matching the installed R source.
translation.value: A function of class progression_handler. On this machine the package lookup stops before that function is returned.
